title: Estimate Type Acceptance Matrix for Repair Estimates & Appointments
content:
Which damage each Repair Estimates & Appointments estimate type accepts, how far a mobile estimator travels, whether an insurance-claim booking must carry the insurer claim number at booking, and the highest estimate total each type may produce as a final, convertible estimate.

| Estimate type | Structural damage | Non-drivable vehicle | Deployed airbag | High-voltage damage | Mobile service radius (miles) | Claim number required at booking | Highest convertible estimate total |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Photo Estimate | No | No | No | No | 0 | No | 3500.00 USD |
| Drive-In Estimate | No | No | No | No | 0 | No | 6000.00 USD |
| Scheduled Estimate | Yes | No | No | No | 0 | No | 25000.00 USD |
| Mobile Estimate | No | Yes | No | No | 25 | No | 8000.00 USD |
| Blueprint Teardown Estimate | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | 0 | Yes | 60000.00 USD |
| Structural Blueprint Estimate | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | 0 | Yes | 95000.00 USD |

## Column meanings

- **Structural damage / Non-drivable vehicle / Deployed airbag / High-voltage damage** — whether the type accepts a vehicle with structural damage, a vehicle that cannot be driven, a vehicle with a deployed airbag, and damage near the high-voltage battery or cabling of a hybrid or electric vehicle.
- **Mobile service radius** — the maximum road distance from the assigned repair center to the vehicle for an on-site visit; 0 means no on-site visit.
- **Claim number required at booking** — whether an insurance-claim booking must carry the insurer claim number at booking.
- **Highest convertible estimate total** — the highest estimate total the type may produce as a final, convertible estimate.

## Reading across a row

- Hypothetical profile: a drivable vehicle with structural damage, no deployed airbag and no high-voltage damage reads "Yes" under structural damage only for the Scheduled Estimate, the Blueprint Teardown Estimate and the Structural Blueprint Estimate.
- Hypothetical profile: a vehicle with a deployed airbag reads "Yes" only for the Blueprint Teardown Estimate and the Structural Blueprint Estimate.
- The Mobile Estimate is the only type with an on-site radius, 25 miles.
